agreements.title: Seller agreements
agreements.intro: Store terms, versions and evidence of approval.
agreements.name: Agreement title
agreements.languageHint: Text is shown in this language without automatic translation. Maximum 12,000 characters.
agreements.publishHint: Use the store's own terms. Komisio does not review their legal content. Published versions are preserved and cannot be edited.
agreements.requireEvidence: Require recorded approval evidence before receiving bags
agreements.confirmPublish: I reviewed the text and receiving requirement. This version should apply to future submissions.
agreements.none: No seller agreement is published. No new agreement prerequisite applies to receiving.
agreements.historyHint: The 20 latest versions. Older versions remain accessible from their receipts.
agreements.adminOnly: Owners and admins can publish agreement versions.
agreements.evidenceHint: Reference an approval that already exists outside Komisio. This is a staff record, not the seller's electronic signature.
agreements.referenceHint: For example: paper agreement TEST-12, or the date and reference of a retained email. Keep the original at the store. Avoid sensitive personal information.
agreements.confirmEvidence: I checked that this evidence concerns this seller and the displayed agreement version.
agreements.available: Evidence exists for the current version
agreements.missing: Evidence is missing for the current version
agreements.noReceiptAgreement: No agreement information was recorded with this receipt.
agreements.noEvidence: No evidence was linked to this receipt.
agreements.evidenceNote: The agreement record does not approve the contents for sale.

intake.exportSellerData: Download all data about this seller (JSON)
intake.title: Intake
intake.intro: Receive the bag now. Review its contents later.
intake.pilot: Pilot: receiving records that the store has the bag. Recorded agreement evidence is not an electronic signature. Item drafts can be saved during inspection; sales come later. No email is sent.
intake.name: Seller name
intake.contactHint: Enter at least an email or phone number. Check whether the seller already exists first.
intake.noSellers: No sellers found. Try another name or register a new seller.
intake.noteHint: For example: blue fabric bag. Avoid sensitive personal information.
intake.custody: I confirm that the store has received this bag. Its contents have not been inspected.
intake.saved: The bag is registered. You can now print its label.
intake.queueHint: 20 bags per page, highest bag number first. Open a bag to continue inspection. New bags may arrive while you browse.
intake.label: View label
intake.limit: Showing up to 50 sellers. Narrow your search if someone is missing.
intake.readOnly: You can view intake. Staff can register sellers and receive bags.
intake.invalid: Check the details and try again.
intake.agreementChanged: The agreement changed. Reload and review the current version before continuing.
intake.agreementRequired: The store requires evidence of seller approval of the current agreement before receiving.
intake.failed: Could not confirm the result. Retry with the same details. Check the list before starting again.
intake.changed: The active store changed. Reload this page before continuing.
intake.denied: You do not have permission. Reload the page to check your access.
intake.inspectionChanged: The draft changed after you opened it. Your edits remain here. Copy anything you want to keep before opening the current revision.
intake.inspectionUnavailable: The draft status changed or it can no longer be edited. Your input remains here. Open the current version before continuing.
intake.possibleDuplicates: A seller with these details is already registered. Open that seller instead, or register anyway.

tagline: More room for things to live again.
help: A trusted foundation for your second-hand store.
name: Name
loginIntro: Welcome back. Your store is waiting for you.
registerIntro: Start with your account. Then create a store or join through an invitation.
invitedRegisterIntro: You followed a store invitation. Create your personal account using the email address that received it. You do not need to create a new store. Already have an account? Use the sign-in link below.
invitedLoginIntro: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return here to accept it. New to Komisio? Choose Create account below.
verifySent: Check your email and follow the link to confirm your account. Open it in the same browser you used here. The link can only be used once.
resetSent: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your email.
authError: The request could not be completed. Check your details and try again.
callbackError: This link could not be used. Request a new link and open it in the same browser.
onboardingIntro: You become the owner and can invite colleagues next. You can work in several stores with the same account.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. For example my-secondhand.
homeIntro: Today's numbers, your next steps and your team.
setupIntro: Build the foundation together with your team.
stepPolicy: Set the store policy with your accountant
stepItem: Receive and accept your first item
teamIntro: Give each colleague the right access, from viewing to administration.
foundationNote: Starting with the foundation. Intake, items and sales will follow in the next stage.
membersIntro: Manage who has access to the store and what they can do.
inviteIntro: The invitation is tied to the specified email address and expires in seven days.
removeConfirm: Remove this person's access to this store? Their account and other stores are unaffected.
roleConfirm: Confirm this change to the person's permissions.
inviteDelivery: Share the link with the recipient. Automatic email is not enabled.
inviteEmailAccepted: The invitation has been submitted for email delivery. You can also share the link below.
inviteEmailUnconfirmed: The invitation was created, but we could not confirm the email submission. Share the link with the recipient.
inviteEmailRestricted: This test environment only emails approved test recipients. You can share the link manually.
readOnlyMembers: You can see who works here. An owner or administrator manages permissions.
tenantIntro: The essentials that help your team find the right place.
tenantImmutable: This identifier distinguishes your store from other stores.
accountIntro: Your personal details follow you across stores.
mfaIntro: Protect your account with an authenticator app.
mfaScan: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app and enter the code.
mfaLoginIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
mfaRecovery: Keep your authenticator safe. Recovery of a lost factor requires help from the operator in this version.
inviteAcceptIntro: Accept using the same email address the invitation was created for.
inviteSwitchAccount: Wrong account? Sign out here and sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return to this link.
inviteRecovery: Open the latest invitation in your inbox. A new invitation replaces earlier links. Already accepted? Go to the overview. If it still does not work, ask the store administrator for a new invitation.
inviteLogin: Sign in or create an account to accept your invitation.
notFound: This page could not be found.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try loading the page again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again and confirm your email address.
errors.INVITATION_INVALID: The invitation is invalid, revoked, already used or intended for another email address.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person already belongs to the store.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check your details and try again.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person no longer belongs to the store.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This identifier is already in use. Choose another.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The store must have at least one owner. Appoint another owner first.
errors.CHAIN_CONFLICT: The store already belongs to a chain.
errors.TENANT_CHANGED: The active store has changed. Reload the page before continuing.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.

inspection.title: Inspect the bag
inspection.pilot: Save item descriptions and continue later. Drafts are not approved for sale.
inspection.savedHint: This revision will be available when you return. It does not approve the item for sale.
inspection.saveHint: Save before leaving this page. Unsaved edits are lost on reload. Avoid personal information in descriptions.
inspection.reload: Open current revision (unsaved edits will be lost)
inspection.listHint: 20 drafts per page in a fixed order that does not change when a new revision is saved. New drafts can arrive while you browse.
inspection.emptyPage: No item drafts on this page. Return to the first page.
inspection.historicalHint: This revision is read-only. Open the current draft to make a new change.
inspection.historyHint: Saved revisions are preserved. Select a revision to see past details and compare them with the latest.
inspection.archiveHint: This applies to the last saved version. Save any description changes first. Archiving does not change what has happened to the physical item.
inspection.confirmStatus: I confirm the change to the draft status.

preparation.title: Prepare this draft for reception
preparation.notice: Compare the saved description with what a seller review needs. Nothing is copied, published or approved here.
preparation.savedOnly: Only this saved version is shown. Unsaved edits are not included; save and refresh before reviewing new changes.
preparation.unverified: These values have not been checked against reception sources. Confirm the description, category and condition before using them.
preparation.next: Steps to check before publishing a seller review
preparation.notChecked: Other receptions, prices and agreements have not been checked here. No reception is linked automatically.

steps.select_reception: Choose or create a reception for the same seller and garment.
steps.record_descriptive_sources: Record sources that support the descriptive values. A draft reference is not a reception source.
steps.review_sourced_price: Review a selling price supported by price evidence.
steps.select_published_terms: Select the published agreement version the seller will read.
steps.review_facts: Review each fact and resolve open questions before publishing.

reviewPriceNotice: This is the price to the buyer, not your payout. Your response does not automatically make the garment available for sale.
reviewDeclined: You declined this version. Your response is saved.
reviewUnavailable: This review is unavailable. Check that you are using the right account. The link may have expired, been revoked or been replaced by a new review. Contact the store for a current link.
reviewResponseError: Your response could not be confirmed. Check the status and retry if no response was saved. The store may have changed the review.
reviewLogin: Sign in or create an account with the email address the store registered for you.
reviewApproved: Your approval is saved for this version. The store will handle the next step.
staffReviewApproved: The seller approved this review. Approval applies to this version and does not make the garment available for sale.
staffReviewDeclined: The seller declined this review. The response applies to this version. A changed proposal needs to be published as a new review.
reviewConfirm: I have reviewed the description, any included photos, proposed price and terms above.

reception.title: Garment reception
reception.intro: One garment, one reviewed proposal and the seller decision.
reception.manual: Describe the garment manually or use AI suggestions if enabled for this store. Staff reviews the evidence before the seller responds.
reception.aiNotice: Running analysis sends this reception's photos, notes and price evidence to OpenAI. Use garment evidence without personal information. Embedded image metadata is removed, but visible text and people are not redacted. Maximum three photos per run.
reception.aiUnavailable: AI is not enabled for this store. You can continue with the manual description and price evidence.
reception.aiReviewNotice: Check every fact, the price and the terms. The confirmation below means you as staff have reviewed the suggestion. The seller responds separately.
reception.aiIncomplete: This suggestion cannot be shared yet. Use the manual path to complete or correct the evidence; outstanding questions must be resolved first.
reception.aiLimit: Store limit reached: ten attempts in 24 hours and at least 20 seconds between attempts.
reception.aiQuota: The store's monthly assistance quota is used up. An owner can raise it under settings.
reception.aiFailed: No usable AI suggestion was received. Evidence may have changed. Reload to check the reception; a new run counts as a new attempt.
reception.aiTransient: The suggestion is saved only when you explicitly publish a reviewed version. Reloading loses an unsaved suggestion. Failed or interrupted runs also count toward the limit.
reception.searchLimit: Showing up to 50 matches. Refine the search if needed.
reception.recentHelp: Showing the 20 latest receptions. Open older receptions using their ID or a saved link.
reception.priceHelp: for example 250 or 250.50. This is not the seller payout.
reception.sourceNotice: A change saves a new source version and invalidates earlier review links. History is retained.
reception.needSources: Save a description and price evidence first.
reception.needTerms: The store needs to publish seller terms first
reception.confirm: I have checked the description, photos, price evidence and full terms above.
reception.expiry: The published version is valid for 24 hours. No link or email is sent automatically.
reception.published: This source version is published. Manage the link below.
reception.exactTerms: Show the exact terms the seller will read
reception.stale: This review is stale or expired. Publish a new review before sharing a link.
reception.awaiting: No response has been saved for this version.
reception.linkNotice: Check the recipient. The link requires sign-in with the same email address. A new link replaces earlier links; copy it immediately. No email is sent.
reception.failed: The action could not be completed. The information may have changed. Reload and check the saved state before continuing.
reception.retry: The response could not be confirmed. Retry the same information or reload and check what was saved.
reception.invalid: Check the fields. Enter a positive price with up to two decimal places, description, evidence source and rationale.
reception.photoFailed: The photo save could not be confirmed. Retry the same file, or reload and check the reception.
reception.photoInvalid: Choose a JPEG or PNG up to 3 MB. A reception can contain up to 20 sources in total.
reception.photoHelp: JPEG or PNG, up to 3 MB and 20 megapixels. Originals are private to staff. New uploads get a reduced copy without camera metadata for the next published review. Check visible people and labels too. Older photos may lack a copy; published reviews never change.
reception.sharedPhotos: Photos included in the published version
reception.queueHelp: Status refers to the latest review. Seller approval does not make the garment available for sale.
reception.custodyHelp: Record that the garment is physically in the store. A session, photos or a seller approval never prove custody. Required before the item can be accepted.
reception.custodyNote: Note (optional, for example where it hangs)
reception.custodyConfirm: I confirm that the store has received this garment.
reception.delegatedNotice: The store sets the price (delegated pricing per store policy). The seller link is optional; acceptance does not need the seller's answer.

queueNextSteps.accept_item: Next: accept the item under the terms in force. The store sets the price unless the policy requires the seller's approval.
queueNextSteps.item_accepted: Done: the item is accepted. Further steps happen in the items list.
queueNextSteps.prepare_evidence: Next: complete photos, description and price evidence.
queueNextSteps.review_changed_evidence: Next: check the changes and publish a new review for the seller to answer.
queueNextSteps.check_store_acceptance_requirements: Next: check the received garment and seller terms before the store decision. Starting sales is not yet supported.
queueNextSteps.review_seller_decline: Next: inspect the declined review. Any changes require a new review.
queueNextSteps.publish_fresh_review: Next: check the details and publish a fresh review if the proposal still applies.
queueNextSteps.issue_review_link: Next: open the reception and create the personal seller link. No email is sent automatically.
queueNextSteps.replace_review_link: Next: open the reception and create a replacement link if the review should be shared again.
queueNextSteps.await_seller_response: Next: await the seller response. Creating a link does not mean the seller has read the review.
queueNextSteps.record_custody: Next: record physical custody of the garment. The seller has approved; nothing proves the garment is in the store yet.

history.title: Version history
history.notice: Summary of saved sources and published proposals. Each response applies only to its proposal version. This is not store acceptance or a complete agreement and image history.
history.unanswered: No response recorded for this version at read time.

reception.confirmFact: I have reviewed this fact and its sources
reception.confirmPrice: I have reviewed the price and its evidence.

batch.notice: Several garments from one seller, up to three photos and eight proposals. Review the images assigned to each garment, including shared overview photos. Incomplete proposals need more evidence. Unsaved proposals are lost on reload.
batch.confirm: I reviewed this garment’s facts, price evidence and assigned photos.
batch.staged: A separate reception and review operation have been saved. The garment is not accepted for sale.
batch.failed: Preparation could not be confirmed. Retry the same row; saved steps are reused. If sources changed, check the reception queue before starting again.

reception.photoSeenBefore: A photo in this reception was uploaded before. Check whether the garment was received already:

operations.title: Proposed operations
operations.intro: Proposals from AI agents wait here. Nothing is published until a staff member approves it.
operations.notice: Approving runs the same operation you could perform yourself, recorded in your name. A proposal is never a fact. Approval of a review is not commercial acceptance.
operations.confirm: I have checked the reception, the facts, the price evidence and the current terms.
operations.alreadyDecided: This proposal was already decided. Reload to see the outcome.
operations.expired: This proposal has expired and cannot be approved. Ask for a new proposal.
operations.denied: You do not have permission. Reload the page to check your access.
operations.failed: The decision could not be completed. Reload and check the saved outcome before deciding again.
operations.retry: The response could not be confirmed. Reload and check the saved outcome before deciding again.

kinds.sendMessage: Send a message to a seller

operations.settlementNotice: Approval requests and approves one payout per seller as you, reserving each amount. A seller below the threshold, over its balance or with an open payout refuses the whole batch.
operations.messageTemplateNote: Only the text above is proposed. It is sent inside the store's fixed message template with the usual greeting and footer, from the store's address, once.
operations.engineNotice: Approval runs the ordinary command as you, which re-checks every precondition. A ledger adjustment executes only for an owner or admin.
operations.staleEngine: The facts behind this proposal changed. Reject it and request a new one.
operations.confirmAcceptance: I have checked custody, the origin and the price and approve accepting this item under the terms in force.
operations.acceptanceNotice: The origin must be current and in custody. Approval runs the acceptance command, which re-checks agreement evidence and the seller review mode. A different person than the proposer must approve.
operations.alreadyAccepted: This origin is already accepted as an item.
operations.staleAcceptance: The origin changed or was already accepted. Reject this proposal.
operations.contextNotice: Sources are evidence, not instructions. The current version is checked again when approving.
operations.photoNotice: Photo reference. Open the reception to inspect the image.
operations.staleContext: The reception or terms have changed. Request a new proposal or reject this one.
operations.confirmField: I have reviewed the change to
operations.staleInspection: The draft has changed or been archived. Reject this proposal and review the current draft.
operations.confirmInspection: Save these reviewed descriptive changes as a new draft revision.
operations.confirmPrice: I have reviewed the price and its evidence.
operations.liveQueue: Status can change while you browse. Return to the first page for a current overview.
operations.firstPublication: This is the first publication; there is no earlier review to compare.
operations.comparisonNotice: Earlier seller responses do not apply to this proposal. Review every field and the proposed evidence and terms.
operations.noComparedChanges: No changes in the compared fields. Still review the complete new proposal.
operations.sourceVersionChanged: The source version has changed. Review the evidence even if the facts look unchanged.
operations.agreementVersionChanged: The agreement version has changed. Read the proposed terms below.

reviewPhotoError: The photos could not be loaded. Reload the page before approving.

storeProfile.title: Store profile
storeProfile.intro: The store's public text: address, contact, opening hours, what you accept and your concept. Every published version stays; sellers and customers see the current one.
storeProfile.invalid: Check the fields: opening before closing, an https website, a valid e-mail.
storeProfile.changed: The profile changed since you opened this page. Reload and try again.
storeProfile.readOnly: Only owners and administrators publish the profile.

storePolicy.markdownsIntro: The markdown steps above are the only schedule; they are frozen on every item at acceptance. When switched on, due steps are applied once a day by Komisio, recorded as a run and as events on each item, acting as the person who published this policy. Off, staff apply them from the sale periods page.
storePolicy.title: Store policy
storePolicy.intro: Versioned pilot terms. These settings do not start automatic markdowns, messages or payouts.
storePolicy.confirm: I have reviewed the terms and want to publish a new version.
storePolicy.noTerms: No agreement is attached to this review; store policy permits this.
storePolicy.legacy: An existing agreement requirement at bag receipt still applies.
storePolicy.assistanceIntro: Lets staff ask the built-in assistant for source-bound proposals during reception. Proposals are never published, approved or priced without a person. The service provider and model are set by Komisio; if the service is switched off server-side, this setting has no effect.
storePolicy.assistanceEnabled: Enable built-in assistance for this store
storePolicy.assistanceQuotaHint: Attempts per calendar month. Empty means no quota; 0 blocks assistance. The 24-hour limit still applies.
storePolicy.notificationsIntro: When switched on, an accepted item, a sold item, an approved or paid payout and an issued statement each send the seller the matching e-mail through the communication log, once per fact. Sellers without an e-mail address are skipped. Every message stays visible on the seller page.
storePolicy.vatIntro: Which VAT treatment applies is the store's decision, made together with its accountant. Komisio computes the selected mode exactly per sale line and records mode, basis and amount; it does not judge whether the choice is correct for your store. No sale can be recorded until both modes are chosen.
storePolicy.consignment_margin: VAT on the store's commission only
storePolicy.consignment_full: VAT on the whole sale price
storePolicy.store_margin: Margin scheme per item, when eligibility is attested
storePolicy.store_full: VAT on the whole sale price
storePolicy.currencyIntro: One currency per store, chosen here and frozen once the first sale, purchase or payout exists. All amounts are in this currency; Komisio converts nothing.

sellerTerms.title: Seller terms
sellerTerms.effective: Terms in force for this seller
sellerTerms.intro: The store policy applies unless a value below is set for this seller. Acceptance freezes the terms in force at that moment onto the item; later changes never touch accepted items.
sellerTerms.publishHint: Leave a field empty to follow the store policy. Every publication is a new version; nothing is edited.
sellerTerms.confirm: I have agreed these terms with the seller and want to publish a new version.

items.title: Items
items.intro: An item exists only after the store accepts an origin under known terms. The origin stays the evidence; the item freezes the terms.
items.searchHint: text in the title or category
items.acceptHint: Acceptance freezes the commission, sale period and agreement evidence in force right now. It requires custody and, per store policy, agreement evidence. It does not start a sale.
items.acceptBlocked: Acceptance needs a published review and recorded custody.
items.priceHint: for example 250 or 250.50. In per-item mode the price must equal the one the seller approved.
items.priceInvalid: Enter a price with up to two decimals.
items.confirm: I confirm that the store accepts this item under the terms in force.
items.termsHint: Recorded at acceptance and never changed. Later policy or seller terms apply to later items only.
items.transferHeading: Move to another store in the chain
items.transferHint: Ends the sale period here with the reason transfer, and receives a bag for the same seller in the other store with one draft carrying this description. The other store accepts it under its own terms; the seller's balance stays here.
items.transferDone: Moved to {store}. The item is ended here and waits in that store's bag queue.

sales.title: Sales
sales.intro: A sale is a fact from the till or a POS provider. Each line freezes price, commission, seller credit and VAT as they were at that moment.
sales.notice: Recording a sale does not pay anyone. Seller balances, returns and payouts follow in later slices.
sales.recordHint: One accepted, unsold item per sale for now. POS sales arrive through their own integration.
sales.noItems: No accepted items are available for sale.
sales.priceInvalid: Enter a price with up to two decimals.
sales.confirm: I confirm the item was sold at this price.
sales.linesHint: Frozen at the sale; later policy or seller terms never change these numbers.

ledger.title: Balance and ledger
ledger.intro: Every seller-facing amount derives from this append-only ledger. Sales credit the seller's share; payouts and returns come later.
ledger.adjustHint: Owner or admin only. A correction is a new entry with a reason; nothing is edited.
ledger.confirm: I have agreed this correction and want it recorded.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: A payout goes from requested to approved to paid, or is rejected. Approval reserves the amount in the seller's ledger; payment settles it.
payouts.notice: Komisio records payouts; it does not move money. Pay through your bank and record the reference here.
payouts.requestHint: On the seller's behalf, up to the available balance and at least the policy minimum. The seller app will request directly later.
payouts.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to two decimals.
payouts.requestConfirm: The seller asked for this payout.
payouts.settleHint: Every seller at or above the minimum ({threshold}) without an open payout. One batch requests and approves a payout of the full available balance per selected seller; you then pay through your bank and mark each one paid.
payouts.settleEmpty: No seller reaches the minimum right now.
payouts.settleReasonHint: Recorded on every approval in the batch, for example "September settlement".
payouts.settleConfirm: I will pay these amounts and record the references.
payouts.settled: The batch is recorded: every selected seller now has an approved payout awaiting payment.

returns.confirm: The customer returned the item and {amount} is refunded in full.
returns.flaggedHint: The seller's credit for these returns had already been reserved or paid out. Settle with the seller and record an adjustment if needed.

statements.title: Settlement statement
statements.intro: A numbered, frozen document computed from the ledger. Corrections are credit notes that reference the original.
statements.footer: Amounts in {currency} including VAT where applicable. This statement is computed from the store's ledger and does not change afterwards.
statements.issueHint: Whole days in local time; the period may not overlap an earlier statement. The next number is assigned on issue.
statements.confirm: I want to issue the next numbered statement for this period.

handovers.title: Handovers
handovers.intro: Sellers announce a bag or a box from their portal and get a reference. Receiving it here records the ordinary bag receipt under the agreement rules; the seller sees the bag number.
handovers.disabled: Self drop-off is off: enable seller_dropoff among the custody sources in the store policy.
handovers.confirm: The bag or box is in the store now.

chain.title: Chain
chain.intro: Group this store with other stores you own under one company name. Access, plans, sellers and integrations stay per store; owners and admins of every store in the chain see the numbers side by side on the economy page.
chain.name: Company name
chain.leave: Take this store out of the chain
chain.leaveHint: Owners only. A chain without stores is removed. Nothing else changes.
chain.none: This store is not part of a chain.

chain.heading: Chain
chain.refused: The chain view needs owner or admin in every store of the chain.
chain.mixed: Stores use different currencies; only the per-store rows are shown.

economy.title: Economy
economy.intro: The store's numbers for a period, computed from the same facts and with the same sums as the day close: sales with VAT per mode, commission, seller credit, returns and paid payouts.
economy.notice: Read only. The figures are the store's own; VAT modes are the store's choice made with its accountant.
economy.periodInvalid: Pick a from date at or before the to date, at most one year apart.
economy.liabilityHint: Current balances across all sellers, not limited to the period: available to request, reserved by approved payouts, and payouts still open.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.intro: Day closes are versioned totals for one local day: sales, VAT per mode, commission, seller credit, returns and payouts. An unchanged day keeps its version; a changed day gets a new one.
accounting.notice: Komisio is not a cash register. Day closes feed your accounting; the Fortnox export follows once your accountant has set the account map.
accounting.generateHint: Pick the local date. Generating again after a late sale creates the next version; earlier versions stay.
accounting.mapIntro: Your accountant decides which account and which side each day-close amount goes to. Komisio proposes no accounts. Amounts left empty are reported but not exported; an export is refused when the voucher does not balance.
accounting.noMap: No account map yet. An owner or admin publishes it with the accountant's account numbers.
accounting.readOnlyMap: Only an owner or admin can change the account map.
accounting.mapMissingLink: No account map yet: set it under Account map and Fortnox before exporting.

communications.title: Messages to the seller
communications.intro: Every message is logged with the exact text as sent and its delivery outcome. Templates are fixed; you may add a plain-text note.
communications.sendHint: Pick what the message is about. In the pilot, delivery goes only to allowlisted addresses; other outcomes are logged.
communications.freeTextHint: Plain text, up to 1000 characters, inserted into the fixed template.
communications.confirm: I want to send this message to the seller's e-mail address.
communications.noEmail: This seller has no e-mail address.

outcomes.restricted: not sent: address not on the pilot allowlist
outcomes.manual: not sent: e-mail delivery is off, hand over manually

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: Margin, sell-through and stock age per category for a period, from the store's own facts. Stock is as of now; sales are those in the period.
stock.notice: Read only. Margin is the store's share: the commission on consignment sales, and price minus VAT minus purchase price on store-owned sales.
stock.notAvailable: The stock report is not available yet on this deployment.
stock.definitions: Sell-through is sold in the period divided by sold plus in stock now. Age buckets follow the default markdown schedule.

importer.title: Import sellers
importer.intro: Bring the sellers from your previous system into this store. Choose a CSV file, check which column holds what, read the preview and stage the import; it is registered when it is approved in the operations queue.
importer.notice: Only names and contact details are imported here. Balances, items and history stay in the old system; agreements are recorded in Komisio when each seller next hands in.
importer.fileHint: First row with column names; comma or semicolon separated; at most 200 sellers per import.
importer.skipHeader: The first row is a header
importer.previewHint: Showing the first ten rows that will be imported.
importer.staged: The import is staged. Approve it in the operations queue to register the sellers.
importer.tooMany: The file has more than 200 usable rows. Split it and import in parts.
importer.nothing: No usable rows. Check the column mapping.
importer.error: The import could not be staged. Reload and try again.
importer.ownerOnly: Only the store owner or an admin can import sellers.

lifecycle.agentOn: Automatic markdowns are on: due steps are applied once a day as the policy's publisher. You can also apply them now.
lifecycle.agentOff: Automatic markdowns are off (store policy). Apply due steps here, one run at a time.
lifecycle.title: Sale periods
lifecycle.intro: Every accepted item carries its frozen sale period and markdown steps. This list says what is due; a person applies a markdown, extends the period or ends it.
lifecycle.notice: Nothing here happens by itself. Markdowns are shares of the accepted price, never compounded. Ending an item as charity or return records the fact; the physical handling is yours.
lifecycle.endConfirm: The item leaves sale and the physical handling is done or arranged.

openByReference.title: Open by label
openByReference.intro: Type or scan the reference printed on a bag label (K-n) or a garment label (G-n).
openByReference.hint: For example K-12 for a bag or G-7 for a garment.
openByReference.notFound: Nothing in this store carries the reference {ref}.

usage.title: Usage this month
usage.intro: Units counted by the engine per calendar month in the store's time zone. Quotas are set in the store policy.

printing.title: Printers and labels
printing.intro: Labels are ZPL programs queued for a store printer. A local agent next to the printer picks up jobs and reports the outcome.
printing.name: Name
printing.addressHint: Host or IP with port, for example 192.168.1.50:9100. Leave empty for USB.
printing.agentHint: Run scripts/print-agent.mjs next to the printer with a dedicated staff account; see docs/PRINT-AGENT.md.
printing.noPrinters: No active printer; use the browser print instead.
printing.itemLabelHint: Price label with the item reference; after a markdown the label shows the old and the new price.
printing.onboardingHint: A slip with the seller reference and a QR code to the seller page.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.intro: Store-owned goods enter here, never through the consignment paths.
purchases.notice: A purchase is a fact about what the store bought and for how much. It is not yet an item for sale; acceptance follows.
purchases.registerHint: One registration per item bought. Keep the receipt or note; its reference is required.
purchases.priceInvalid: Enter a price with up to two decimals.
purchases.evidenceHint: Receipt number, or a note of who sold it and when. Avoid personal identity numbers.
purchases.marginEligible: Margin scheme eligible: bought from a private person without VAT, with per-item documentation
purchases.marginHint: This is attested now, at the purchase, by you. The store's VAT mode decides how it is used at sale.
purchases.confirm: I confirm that the store bought this item and that the evidence reference is correct.
purchases.recentHint: The 20 latest purchases. Older ones are reachable from their items once accepted.

sellerPortal.handoverIntro: Announce a bag or a box before you bring it. Show the reference at the counter; the store records it as your bag and you see the bag number here.
sellerPortal.handoverDisabled: This store does not take announced drop-offs yet. Bring your items to the counter.
sellerPortal.showReference: Show this reference at the counter or at the locker.
sellerPortal.title: My sales
sellerPortal.empty: No seller matches your verified email. Contact the store if an account is missing.
sellerPortal.notice: A request moves no money. The store reviews and handles payment.
sellerPortal.error: Unable to save. Check the amount and reload for the current balance.
sellerPortal.recent: The latest 100 records appear in each list. Balance includes the full history.

plans.heading: Plan
plans.priceNote: Hosted Komisio: 30 days free from store creation, then SEK 199 per store and month excluding VAT. Self-hosted Komisio is free.

explain.trial: Everything works during the trial. Activate the subscription before it ends to keep recording new items and sales.
explain.past_due: The last payment failed. The store keeps working during the grace period; after that it becomes read-only until the payment is settled.
explain.read_only: Everything can be read and exported, but nothing new is recorded: no reception, sales, markdowns or payout requests. Activate the subscription to continue.
explain.closed: The store is closed by its owner. Data stays readable and exportable.

plans.trialEndingSoon: Your free trial ends in {days} days.
plans.pastDue: Payment overdue: the store becomes read-only in {days} days.
plans.readOnly: This store is read-only until its subscription is activated.
plans.contactToActivate: Contact Komisio to activate the subscription.
plans.hostIntro: Every store on this deployment with its plan state. Manual activation is for invoice customers and the pilot; the reason is recorded.
plans.untilOptional: Active until (optional; empty means until further notice)

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not a platform host.
errors.BILLING_DISABLED: Billing is not enabled on this deployment.
errors.PLAN_CLOSED: The store is closed by its owner and cannot be reactivated here.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the date and the reason.
errors.STRIPE_REQUEST_FAILED: Stripe could not be reached. Retry later.
errors.NO_CUSTOMER: There is no subscription to manage yet.

plans.checkoutSuccess: Thank you. The subscription is registered as soon as Stripe confirms the payment, usually within a minute.
plans.checkoutCancelled: The checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
plans.notConfigured: Online payment is not configured on this deployment; contact Komisio to activate the subscription.

reconciliation.heading: Reconciliation
reconciliation.hint: Every day with activity in the period and where its books stand: close, export under the current map, and Fortnox. Read only; the day close totals decide.
reconciliation.periodInvalid: Pick a from date at or before the to date, at most one year apart.
reconciliation.allDone: Every active day in the period is sent to Fortnox.

statuses.close_stale: Facts changed after the close; generate it again
statuses.export_outdated: Exported under an older map; export again

brief.heading: Brief
brief.hint: A fixed rendering of the same numbers for the last week or month and the one before. No forecast; nothing is stored.
brief.salesLine: {sales} sales for {gross} in total, {average} per sale.
brief.comparedUp: That is {percent}% more than the previous period ({previousFrom} – {previousTo}: {previousGross}).
brief.comparedDown: That is {percent}% less than the previous period ({previousFrom} – {previousTo}: {previousGross}).
brief.comparedSame: That is the same as the previous period ({previousFrom} – {previousTo}).
brief.comparedNoBase: The previous period ({previousFrom} – {previousTo}) had no sales.
brief.creditLine: Sellers earned {credit}; the store's commission was {commission}.
brief.acceptedLine: {accepted} items accepted, {previousAccepted} in the previous period.
brief.liabilityLine: Owed to sellers now: {owed} across {sellers} sellers.
brief.emailFooter: Komisio · the weekly brief is written from the store's own numbers, the same as on the economy page: {link}

email.heading: Weekly brief by e-mail
email.hint: Every Monday morning the owners get last week's brief by e-mail. It is switched on per store by an owner and sent by the automation identity.
email.enabled: On: the brief is sent every Monday.
email.waiting: Switched on; the first run confirms it.
email.notConfigured: Automation is not configured on this deployment.
email.ownerOnly: Only the store owner switches this on.

shopify.title: Shopify connection
shopify.intro: Connect the store to its Shopify shop. This step only connects, verifies and disconnects; products and orders follow.
shopify.connected: Shopify connected. The shop was verified against the domain you named before the token was stored.
shopify.disconnected: Shopify disconnected. The stored token was removed.
shopify.connectionFailed: Could not verify the connection. Check configuration or retry later.
shopify.connectionUnavailable: The pilot connection is not bound to this store.
shopify.connectionTenantMissing: The deployed configuration is missing the store binding (SHOPIFY_PILOT_TENANT_ID).
shopify.connectionClientMissing: The deployed configuration has a missing or malformed client ID (SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID).
shopify.connectionSecretMissing: The client secret is missing from the deployed configuration (SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET).
shopify.configHint: Register the Komisio app in Shopify's Dev Dashboard and set the variables in Vercel; redeploy after changes. No credential values are shown here.
shopify.notice: Tokens are stored encrypted with a server-side key. Only the shop's name, domain and currency are visible here.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this store.
errors.TENANT_CHANGED: The active store changed during the connection. Retry from the store you meant to connect.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Enter the shop's myshopify domain, for example my-store.myshopify.com.
errors.SHOPIFY_NOT_CONNECTED: This store is not connected to Shopify, or the pilot configuration is incomplete.
errors.SHOPIFY_AUTH_REQUIRED: Shopify did not accept the authorisation, or the token has expired. Connect again.
errors.SHOPIFY_CONNECTION_FAILED: Shopify could not be reached. Retry later.
errors.SHOPIFY_RATE_LIMITED: Shopify is rate limiting requests. Retry in a minute.
errors.SHOPIFY_READ_FAILED: Shopify answered with an error while reading the shop.
errors.SHOPIFY_WRONG_SHOP: The shop that authorised is not the shop you named. Nothing was stored.
errors.SHOPIFY_STATE_INVALID: The connection attempt expired or did not start here. Connect again.
errors.CREDENTIAL_KEY_MISSING: The deployed configuration is missing the credential key (KOMISIO_CREDENTIAL_KEY).
errors.CREDENTIAL_UNREADABLE: The stored token cannot be read with the current credential key. Disconnect and connect again.

fortnox.reconcileHint: Compare the voucher in the pinned Fortnox company with this export's date, amounts and lines before confirming. This records your verification; it does not send a voucher.
fortnox.reconcileEvidence: Evidence: what you checked, when and by whom
fortnox.reconcileNoAbsent: If you cannot find the voucher, leave the send held. This form cannot confirm absence or allow a resend.
fortnox.title: Fortnox connection
fortnox.intro: Connect the store to its Fortnox company. This slice only connects, verifies and disconnects; no voucher is sent yet.
fortnox.connected: Fortnox connected. The company was verified against the expected name before the token was stored.
fortnox.disconnected: Fortnox disconnected. The stored token was removed.
fortnox.connectionFailed: Could not verify the connection. Check configuration or retry later.
fortnox.databasePinned: The company database matches the pinned number.
fortnox.databaseUnpinned: Pin this database number in configuration (FORTNOX_EXPECTED_DATABASE_NUMBER) before any export is enabled.
fortnox.connectionUnavailable: The pilot connection is not bound to this store.
fortnox.connectionTenantMissing: The deployed configuration is missing the store binding (FORTNOX_PILOT_TENANT_ID).
fortnox.connectionClientMissing: The deployed configuration has a missing or malformed client ID.
fortnox.connectionSecretMissing: The client secret is missing from the deployed configuration.
fortnox.connectionCompanyNameMissing: The expected company name is missing from the deployed configuration (FORTNOX_EXPECTED_COMPANY_NAME).
fortnox.configHint: Check the store binding and Vercel settings (Production). Redeploy after changes. No credential values are shown here.
fortnox.ownerOnly: Only the store owner or an admin can connect Fortnox.
fortnox.notice: Tokens are stored encrypted with a server-side key. Only the connected company's name and database number are visible here.
fortnox.sendNeedsConnection: Connect Fortnox to send this voucher.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this store.
errors.TENANT_CHANGED: The active store changed during the connection. Retry from the store you meant to connect.
errors.FORTNOX_NOT_CONNECTED: This store is not connected to Fortnox, or the pilot configuration is incomplete.
errors.FORTNOX_AUTH_REQUIRED: Fortnox did not accept the authorisation. Connect again.
errors.FORTNOX_CONNECTION_CHANGED: The Fortnox connection changed during renewal. Check the connection before trying again.
errors.FORTNOX_REFRESH_SAVE_FAILED: The renewed authorisation could not be saved. Check the connection; it may need to be connected again.
errors.FORTNOX_REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE: Safe token renewal is not available yet. Wait for the database deployment and try again.
errors.FORTNOX_REFRESH_INVALID_GRANT: Fortnox needs to be connected again. The saved renewal token is no longer accepted.
errors.FORTNOX_CONNECTION_FAILED: Fortnox could not be reached. Retry later.
errors.FORTNOX_RATE_LIMITED: Fortnox is rate limiting requests. Retry in a minute.
errors.FORTNOX_READ_FAILED: Fortnox answered with an error while reading the company.
errors.FORTNOX_WRONG_COMPANY: The authorised Fortnox company is not the expected one. Nothing was stored. Choose the expected company in Fortnox and connect again.
errors.FORTNOX_STATE_INVALID: The connection attempt expired or did not start here. Connect again.
errors.CREDENTIAL_KEY_MISSING: The deployed configuration is missing the credential key (KOMISIO_CREDENTIAL_KEY).
errors.CREDENTIAL_UNREADABLE: The stored token cannot be read with the current credential key. Disconnect and connect again.
errors.FORTNOX_ALREADY_SENT: This export is already sent to Fortnox.
errors.FORTNOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS: This export has a pending send. Do not resend; if it remains pending, reconcile it with Fortnox.
errors.FORTNOX_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The Fortnox outcome is uncertain. Do not send again. Ask the owner and operator to reconcile the export with Fortnox.
errors.FORTNOX_PREFLIGHT_FAILED: The send stopped before posting to Fortnox. Check the connection before retrying.
errors.FORTNOX_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: Only stores in SEK can send vouchers to Fortnox in this version.
errors.FORTNOX_VOUCHER_REJECTED: Fortnox did not accept the voucher. Check the account numbers in the map and the financial year in Fortnox.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request id was used for another send.

zettle.automaticHint: Checks every ten minutes, up to 100 receipts per run. Facts are recorded by the automation identity under the owner's grant.
zettle.automaticPending: Waiting for the automation identity to accept
zettle.automaticUnconfigured: The deployment automation identity is not configured.

automaticOutcomes.failed: Failed — cursor retained; inspect the window

zettle.title: Zettle integration
zettle.intro: Send accepted items to Zettle. Matched checkout receipts automatically record the sale and seller credit.
zettle.offline: Live Zettle synchronization is not enabled. A connection check does not start synchronization.
zettle.fixture: LOCAL TEST ONLY: products and checkout purchases are simulated. No real Zettle account is contacted.
zettle.failed: Could not complete. Reload and check the current receipt before trying again.
zettle.retry: Response unknown. Retry the same request.
zettle.matchHint: Copy the full item ID from the end of its page URL. Match each row to a different item.
zettle.unsupported: Discounts, refunds, fees and non-unit quantities need a later integration slice.

errors.ZETTLE_CURSOR_CHANGED: Another sync finished first. Reload before syncing again.
errors.ZETTLE_PURCHASE_CONFLICT: This receipt has changed in Zettle. Investigate the original receipt; no existing sale was changed.
errors.ZETTLE_MATCH_CHANGED: The matching changed. Reload and review the latest version.
errors.ZETTLE_ALREADY_RECORDED: This receipt is already recorded. Its matching cannot change.
errors.ZETTLE_UNMATCHED_LINES: Match every row. The receipt is recorded automatically after the final match.
errors.ZETTLE_UNSUPPORTED_PURCHASE: This receipt needs investigation in Zettle. Unsupported amounts or discounts are never guessed.
errors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: The item was not found in this store. Check its full ID.
errors.ITEM_ALREADY_SOLD: An item has already been sold. Check the receipt and matching.
errors.VAT_MODE_NOT_SET: Choose the store VAT mode in settings before recording sales.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check that every row points to a different item with a valid ID.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request no longer matches the recorded attempt. Reload and check the result.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your current role or sign-in cannot perform this action.
errors.ZETTLE_VAT_MAPPING_REQUIRED: VAT mapping is missing for this item mode.
errors.ZETTLE_REMOTE_CHANGED: The product changed in Zettle. Investigate the difference.
errors.ZETTLE_REMOTE_MISSING: A previously synced product is missing in Zettle.
errors.ZETTLE_WRONG_MERCHANT: The connection belongs to another merchant.
errors.ZETTLE_RATE_LIMITED: Zettle is rate limiting requests. Retry later.
errors.ZETTLE_WINDOW_INVALID: Zettle returned data outside the selected interval. Retrieval stopped.
errors.ZETTLE_WINDOW_COMPLETE: This interval is already complete. Reload the page.
errors.ZETTLE_WINDOW_ABANDONED: The owner closed this interval. No more pages can be imported into it. Reload the page.
errors.ZETTLE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Zettle rejected authentication. Check the API key and its permissions.
errors.ZETTLE_CONNECTION_FAILED: Could not verify the connection. Check configuration or retry later.
errors.ZETTLE_INVENTORY_FAILED: Zettle stock could not be confirmed. Check the saved item status before taking further action.
errors.ZETTLE_INVENTORY_CONFLICT: Zettle stock could not be confirmed. Check the saved item status before taking further action.
errors.ZETTLE_INVENTORY_AMBIGUOUS: Zettle stock could not be confirmed. Check the saved item status before taking further action.
errors.ZETTLE_STOCK_HELD: Zettle stock could not be confirmed. Check the saved item status before taking further action.
errors.ZETTLE_IMAGE_INVALID: The photo could not be read or is too small or invalid. Image export stopped.
errors.ZETTLE_IMAGE_FAILED: Image upload was not confirmed. No stock was changed. Check image status before continuing.
errors.ZETTLE_IMAGE_HELD: The previous image upload is uncertain. Manual reconciliation is required; it will not be uploaded twice.
errors.ZETTLE_IMAGE_PRODUCT_REQUIRED: Export the product before exporting its photo.
errors.ZETTLE_EXPORT_FAILED: The product step failed. No stock increment started. Check the product attempt before retrying.
errors.ZETTLE_PRODUCT_UUID_REJECTED: Zettle rejected the product identifier. The export is held for a safe identity correction.
errors.ZETTLE_IDENTITY_HELD: The product identity cannot be changed safely. Review the earlier export and stock history.
errors.ZETTLE_PRODUCT_ACCESS_DENIED: Zettle denied access to the product library. Check the API key product permissions.
errors.ZETTLE_PRODUCT_REJECTED: Zettle rejected the product request (HTTP 400/422). Stock initialization did not start.
errors.ZETTLE_PRODUCT_RESPONSE_INVALID: Zettle returned an unsupported product response format. The product may exist; do not create a new product ID.
errors.ZETTLE_PRODUCT_FIELDS_UNSUPPORTED: The Zettle product contains additional fields Komisio must handle before export can continue.
errors.ZETTLE_CREATE_FAILED: Zettle did not confirm product creation. Reconcile using the same product ID.
errors.ZETTLE_UPDATE_FAILED: Zettle did not confirm the product update.
errors.ZETTLE_READ_FAILED: The product or integration records could not be read.
errors.ZETTLE_RETRY_LATER: Zettle returned a server error. Retry later using the same product ID.

zettle.approvalHint: Matched receipts are recorded automatically. Only exceptions need investigation; no second approver is required.
zettle.held: The receipt could not be recorded. Investigate before retrying.
zettle.catalogIssues: Receipts were read. Some products could not sync; check product status.
zettle.catalogHint: Prices come from Komisio. External changes in Zettle are checked before updating.
zettle.vatHint: Set the POS VAT rate for each mode. Blank blocks export for that mode. This does not change Komisio VAT calculations. Verify against the merchant settings and accounting before live use.
zettle.catalogOffline: Exports and receipt retrieval are started manually. No scheduled synchronization is enabled.
zettle.pullHint: Retrieval starts at activation time. Each click fetches at most 100 receipts. Matched purchases are recorded automatically; other receipts await resolution. This starts no scheduled retrieval or product export.
zettle.vatComparisonHint: Comparison only: identical percentages do not guarantee the same taxable basis, especially for margin VAT. Confirm the mapping with your accountant. No values are corrected automatically.

vatComparison.mismatch: Warning: differs from the engine rate
vatComparison.invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals

zettle.abandonWarning: Unfetched receipts may be missing. Closing skips the rest of this interval and requires manual reconciliation against Zettle. No sales are created or removed.
zettle.pullWaiting: No new interval yet. Retrieval trails by two minutes to allow Zettle to process purchases.
zettle.connectionHint: Verify the server-held credential and its Zettle merchant. This check creates no products and imports no sales.
zettle.connectionUnavailable: The pilot connection is not bound to this store.
zettle.connectionTenantMissing: The deployed configuration is missing the store binding (ZETTLE_PILOT_TENANT_ID).
zettle.connectionClientMissing: The deployed configuration has a missing or malformed client ID.
zettle.connectionKeyMissing: The API key is missing from the deployed configuration.
zettle.connectionMerchantInvalid: The configured Zettle merchant ID is malformed.
zettle.connectionConfigHint: Check the store binding and Vercel settings (Production). Redeploy after changes. No credential values are shown here.
zettle.connectionFailed: Could not verify the connection. Check configuration or retry later.
zettle.merchantPinned: The merchant matches the pinned connection.
zettle.merchantUnpinned: Pin this merchant ID in configuration before enabling synchronization.
zettle.stockHint: Export one item at a time. The first attempt adds one tracked unit. Later attempts check the result and update the price without replenishing stock. Up to 50 recorded attempts are shown; unresolved attempts come first.
zettle.imageHint: After exporting the item, send the first photo from its accepted reception review to Zettle. A reduced copy becomes product imagery there; visible people or labels are not redacted. Originals stay private. This action does not change stock.

imageStates.no_photo: No photo in the accepted reception review. Purchase and inspection origins have no exportable photo in this version.
imageStates.held: Image upload unconfirmed. Manual reconciliation is required; no automatic re-upload.
imageStates.uploaded: Photo uploaded; product association needs checking. Retry image export.

stockStates.depleted: Sold or removed in Zettle - not restocked
stockStates.unknown: Uncertain result - no new unit will be added
stockStates.conflict: Stock needs investigation - no new unit will be added

priceEvidence.title: Comparable sales in this store
priceEvidence.intro: What this store accepted and later sold, from its own sales. Evidence for a price, never a price; the store decides.
priceEvidence.notice: Returned items are excluded. Prices are what this store recorded; nothing is fetched from outside.

To keep going, activate the subscription under Settings:
